title: Arabic chain switches, shared continuation and scoped full report meaning
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: complete Muslim1907a/b with Ibn al-Salah’s actual chain-switch rule; coordination, shared continuation, conditional content and restricted variant have different consequences under the same name inventory.

design.structural_baseline: Directed word composition, hierarchy at spaces, whole-form residuals and entry context are measured background; none identifies these external mechanisms. No confirmed word is required for an explicit future hypothesis.
design.access: Source-only; no target packet, image, reserved data, new admission, decoder, solver, statistics, process management, contact, refresh or commit.
design.whole_hypothesis: Complete attributed assertions may be written once with explicit alternative transmission paths, common continuation references and scoped wording variants. The content itself must be represented as the full intention/migration conditional argument, not an opaque payload.
design.source_dates_and_ownership: Muslim ninth century and Ibn al-Salah thirteenth century; modern Arabic transcriptions only. Exact online edition of Ibn al-Salah unspecified. No medieval graphic witness admitted.
complete_content: First entry: Abd Allah ibn Maslama ibn Qanab reports from Malik, from Yahya ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Alqama ibn Waqqas, from Umar ibn al-Khattab, who attributes the saying to the Prophet. Retain each attribution verb and the blessing.
General assertion: deeds are by intention; each person has what that person intended. Interpretive reward/value gloss remains hypothetical, not an added source noun.
Conditional1: migration to God and His messenger is migration to God and His messenger. Repeated wording is preserved, not removed as a tautology.
Conditional2: migration for worldly gain or marrying a woman is migration to that for which one migrated. Gain and marriage are different embedded purposes; the two alternatives are retained.
Second record supplies every alternative entry narrator and every immediate source, including alias explanations and one coordinated pair.
All branch-ending sources link to Yahya ibn Said through Malik’s already owned chain and the meaning of his report.
Sufyan’s version supplies a quoted hearing of Umar on the pulpit reporting from the Prophet; speaker scope unresolved in the abbreviated record, not silently assigned to Sufyan.
complete_branch_inventory: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr

attested_context_operations.ح: Switch to another chain rather than continue the first. Competing etymologies and oral conventions are retained.
attested_context_operations.حدثنا_and_أخبرنا: Distinct written reporting formulas, with abbreviations attested by the rule; do not flatten into an untyped edge or claim the same mode of acquisition.
attested_context_operations.و: Coordination of sources, distinct from serial عن; rule paragraph explicitly warns about confusing them, with tentative historical sign interpretation.
attested_context_operations.كلهم عن: All previously enumerated terminal sources share the named continuation.
attested_context_operations.بإسناد مالك ومعنى حديثه: Refer to the named earlier chain and meaning, not literal wording.
attested_context_operations.وفي حديث سفيان: Restrict the additional wording to one named version.
attested_context_operations.من...ف... and ما...إليه: Conditional person/goal co-reference within the complete matn; ordinary Arabic syntax supplies the participants and alternatives.

design.finite_content_contract: For this bounded source: REPORT(path, proposition); ALT_PATHS(list of report-form/name paths, common-tail-ID, same-meaning-ID); ALIAS(name, expanded-name); VARIANT(path-ID, quoted-clause, unresolved-speaker-ID). The proposition uses only GENERAL(deeds, intention), DUE(person, intended-goal), IF(MIGRATE(person, goal), MIGRATION_TO(person, same-goal)), goal alternatives GOD_AND_MESSENGER / WORLD_TO_GAIN / WOMAN_TO_MARRY. This is an analyst inventory, not a historical programming language or surface code. Ordinary speech attribution, blessings and unresolved scope are explicit fields, not dropped.

different_rivals.rival: Treat every ح as ordinary serial continuation.
different_rivals.consequence: Produces a long chain joining distinct immediate teachers, contrary to the stated all-to-Yahya continuation and source rule.

different_rivals.rival: Replace the coordinated Hafs/Yazid sources by a serial from-edge.
different_rivals.consequence: Changes the number and structure of report paths while preserving the same name bag; it gives one transmitter authority from the other without written license.

different_rivals.rival: Treat same meaning as exact same words.
different_rivals.consequence: Cannot retain the separately signalled Sufyan wording variant as a variant rather than a contradiction.

different_rivals.rival: Make all conditional migration outcomes a common fixed destination.
different_rivals.consequence: Destroys the written dependency of the last outcome upon its own worldly/marital intention.

pitfalls: Full Arabic ordinary syntax is still needed for the proposition; attribution shorthand alone is not a whole passage writer.
No globally shared cipher spelling, paragraph boundary policy or fixed token count is licensed.
Aliases are not new independent people. Shared tail means these paths are not independent witnesses.
Complete report1907b has an unresolved embedded speaker in its wording variant.
Semantic interpretation of the migration assertions is not the historical truth of the asserted events.
Person-ID renaming and report-form relabeling symmetries remain without external ownership.

predecessors.retained: Its failed fixed whole-source grapheme map is not reopened. This proposal concerns scoped source reference, not Arabic/Hebrew alphabet substitution.
No extension of D/E alphabet; ordinary prose debt is explicitly retained here too.

design.smallest_future_decision: Determine whether a complete admitted passage can sustain a single report/path/reference grammar including all content, with coordination versus sequence and restricted variant scope producing different literal consequences. No target is nominated in this card.
